items.title: 3.3.2 Complexity Classes (P, NP, NP-hard, NP-complete) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of complexity classes (PDF 74).

blocks.text: Maslon ki complexity samajhne ke liye unhein alag alag categories (classes) mein rakha jata hai, is base par ke woh hal ho sakte hain ya nahi aur hal mein kitna waqt lagta hai. Agle topics mein chaar classes aati hain: P, NP, NP-hard aur NP-complete.

blocks.prompt: Chaar complexity classes ke naam bataiye.

items: Complexity classes: P, NP, NP-hard, NP-complete.
